ambiguities_or_notes: «привести в ясность количество дров и их распределение, равно и все другие дела» is rendered closely as 'clarify the quantity of firewood and its distribution, as well as all the other matters'; no more specific administrative meaning is supplied than the source gives.
The repetition in «расскажите и разъясните ему всё» is preserved as 'tell him everything and explain everything to him' rather than compressed into one English verb.

«все его распоряжения исполняйте» is rendered 'carry out all his instructions'; Strakhov is explicitly acting on Tolstoy's behalf, but the English does not intensify «распоряжения» into a stronger military or official 'orders'.

«а другое он сам решит как лучше, с вашим советом» is kept as 'he himself will decide the rest as he thinks best, with your advice,' preserving both Strakhov's discretion and Ermolaev's advisory role.

In editorial note [1], famine-relief «столовые» is rendered contextually as 'soup kitchens'; this identifies the relief institutions rather than ordinary commercial dining rooms and does not alter Tolstoy's body text.
